    <!-- Script Logic -->
    <script>
        let currentSettings = { repo: '', reviewers: '', mappings: '' };
        let isSlackConnected = false;

        async function initApp() {
            await window.archestra.ready;
            
            document.getElementById('userGreeting').textContent = `Welcome, ${window.archestra.user.name}`;

            // Check Slack connectivity via tools list
            try {
                const tools = await window.archestra.tools.list();
                if (tools && Array.isArray(tools)) {
                    isSlackConnected = tools.some(t => t.name && t.name.toLowerCase().includes('slack'));
                }
            } catch (err) {
                isSlackConnected = false;
            }

            updateSlackConnectionUI();

            // Load saved settings
            try {
                const res = await window.archestra.storage.user.get('shipwindow_settings');
                if (res && res.value) {
                    currentSettings = res.value;
                    document.getElementById('settingRepo').value = currentSettings.repo || '';
                    document.getElementById('settingReviewers').value = currentSettings.reviewers || '';
                    document.getElementById('settingMappings').value = currentSettings.mappings || '';
                    document.getElementById('execRepo').value = currentSettings.repo || '';
                    
                    updateAnalyzerState();
                    renderReviewers(null, {});
                } else {
                    renderReviewers(null, {});
                }
            } catch (err) {
                renderReviewers(null, {});
            }

            setupEvents();
        }

        function updateSlackConnectionUI() {
            const badgeContainer = document.getElementById('slackConnectionBadgeContainer');
            const notifyContainer = document.getElementById('slackActionContainer');

            if (!isSlackConnected) {
                badgeContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(148,163,184,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.15); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8;">
                        <span>🔒 Connect Slack MCP server in Registry</span>
                    </div>
                `;
                notifyContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="btn-locked" disabled>
                        <span>🔒 Notify Me on Slack</span>
                    </button>
                `;
            } else {
                badgeContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 10px; color: #34d399;">
                        <span>🟢 Slack MCP Connected</span>
                    </div>
                `;
                notifyContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <button id="notifySlackBtn" class="btn-cyan">
                        <span>💬 Notify Me on Slack</span>
                    </button>
                `;
                document.getElementById('notifySlackBtn').onclick = () => {
                    alert('Slack notification triggered for the active optimal shipping window!');
                };
            }
        }

        function renderReviewers(loadMap, presenceMap) {
            const revContent = document.getElementById('reviewer-container');
            const reviewersStr = document.getElementById('settingReviewers').value.trim();
            const list = reviewersStr ? reviewersStr.split(',').map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

            if (list.length === 0) {
                revContent.innerHTML = '<p style="font-style: italic; color: #64748b;">Configure reviewers in Settings...</p>';
                return;
            }

            let html = '<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto;">';
            list.forEach(rev => {
                const count = loadMap && loadMap[rev] !== undefined ? loadMap[rev] : 0;
                
                let barColor = '#10b981'; // Green <= 2
                if (count >= 5) barColor = '#ef4444'; // Red >= 5
                else if (count >= 3) barColor = '#f59e0b'; // Yellow 3-4

                let presenceDot = '🔘';
                let tooltip = 'Slack disconnected';
                if (isSlackConnected) {
                    presenceDot = presenceMap[rev] === true ? '🟢' : '🔘';
                    tooltip = presenceMap[rev] === true ? 'Active on Slack' : 'Away';
                }

                html += `
                    <div style="padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
                            <span style="font-weight: 600; color: #f1f5f9;">@${rev}</span>
                            <span style="cursor: help;" title="${tooltip}">${presenceDot}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 4px;">
                            <span>Reviewer load</span>
                            <span>${count} active PRs</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="progress-bar-container">
                            <div class="progress-bar" style="width: ${Math.min(100, (count / 6) * 100)}%; background-color: ${barColor};"></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            html += '</div>';
            revContent.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function setupEvents() {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('settingsDrawer');
            
            document.getElementById('toggleSettings').onclick = () => drawer.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
            document.getElementById('closeSettings').onclick = () => drawer.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';

            document.getElementById('toggleOverride').onclick = () => {
                const oc = document.getElementById('overrideContainer');
                const arrow = document.getElementById('overrideArrow');
                if (oc.style.display === 'none') {
                    oc.style.display = 'block';
                    arrow.textContent = '▲';
                } else {
                    oc.style.display = 'none';
                    arrow.textContent = '▼';
                }
            };

            document.getElementById('saveSettings').onclick = async () => {
                const data = {
                    repo: document.getElementById('settingRepo').value.trim(),
                    reviewers: document.getElementById('settingReviewers').value.trim(),
                    mappings: document.getElementById('settingMappings').value.trim()
                };
                await window.archestra.storage.user.set('shipwindow_settings', data);
                currentSettings = data;
                document.getElementById('execRepo').value = data.repo;
                updateAnalyzerState();
                renderReviewers(null, {});
                drawer.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
            };

            document.getElementById('analyzeBtn').onclick = runAnalyze;
        }

        function updateAnalyzerState() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('analyzeBtn');
            const warn = document.getElementById('repoWarning');
            const repoVal = document.getElementById('settingRepo').value.trim();

            if (repoVal) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                warn.style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                btn.disabled = true;
                warn.style.display = 'flex';
            }
        }

        async function safeCall(tool, args) {
            try {
                let res = await window.archestra.tools.call(tool, args);
                if (typeof res === 'string') {
                    try { return JSON.parse(res); } catch(e) { return res; }
                }
                return res;
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(`Tool ${tool} failed:`, err);
                if (err && err.code === 'auth_required') throw err;
                return null;
            }
        }

        async function runAnalyze() {
            const ring = document.getElementById('statusRing');
            const icon = document.getElementById('statusIcon');
            const title = document.getElementById('statusTitle');
            const sub = document.getElementById('statusSubtitle');
            const conflictContent = document.getElementById('conflict-container');
            const authErrorContainer = document.getElementById('authErrorContainer');

            authErrorContainer.style.display = 'none';
            authErrorContainer.innerHTML = '';

            // Scanning State
            ring.className = "status-ring glow-ring-scanning";
            icon.innerHTML = '⚙️';
            title.textContent = "Scanning...";
            sub.textContent = "Analyzing Conflicts";
            conflictContent.innerHTML = '<p style="font-style: italic; color: #64748b;">Processing commits and live branches...</p>';

            const repoFull = document.getElementById('execRepo').value.trim();
            const [owner, repo] = repoFull.split('/');
            const headBranch = document.getElementById('execFeature').value.trim();
            const manualOverride = document.getElementById('manualOverrideInput').value.trim();

            let myFiles = [];
            let openPRs = [];

            // 1. Get branch files with sha parameter
            try {
                if (manualOverride) {
                    myFiles = manualOverride.split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                } else {
                    const commit = await safeCall('github__get_commit', { owner, repo, sha: headBranch });
                    if (commit && commit.files) {
                        myFiles = commit.files.map(f => f.filename);
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (err && err.code === 'auth_required' && err.url) {
                    handleAuthError(err.url);
                    return;
                }
                if (manualOverride) myFiles = manualOverride.split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            }

            // 2. Fetch Open PRs using list_pull_requests or search_pull_request
            try {
                const searchRes = await safeCall('github__list_pull_requests', { owner, repo, state: 'open' }) || await safeCall('github__search_pull_request', { owner, repo, state: 'open' });
                if (searchRes && Array.isArray(searchRes)) {
                    openPRs = searchRes;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (err && err.code === 'auth_required' && err.url) {
                    handleAuthError(err.url);
                    return;
                }
            }

            // 3. Inspect PR details and count reviewer workloads
            let conflicts = [];
            let reviewerPRCount = {};
            const reviewersStr = document.getElementById('settingReviewers').value.trim();
            const reviewersList = reviewersStr ? reviewersStr.split(',').map(r => r.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

            reviewersList.forEach(rev => { reviewerPRCount[rev] = 0; });

            for (const pr of openPRs) {
                const pullNum = pr.number || pr.pull_number || pr.id;
                if (!pullNum) continue;

                if (pr.assignees && Array.isArray(pr.assignees)) {
                    reviewersList.forEach(rev => {
                        if (pr.assignees.some(a => a.login === rev)) {
                            reviewerPRCount[rev] = (reviewerPRCount[rev] || 0) + 1;
                        }
                    });
                } else if (pr.user && pr.user.login) {
                    if (reviewerPRCount.hasOwnProperty(pr.user.login)) {
                        reviewerPRCount[pr.user.login] = (reviewerPRCount[pr.user.login] || 0) + 1;
                    }
                }

                let prFiles = [];
                let isDraft = pr.draft === true;

                try {
                    const prData = await safeCall('github__pull_request_read', { owner, repo, pullNumber: Number(pullNum), method: "get" });
                    if (prData) {
                        if (prData.files) prFiles = prData.files.map(f => f.filename);
                        if (prData.draft !== undefined) isDraft = prData.draft;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('Failed to read PR #' + pullNum);
                }

                myFiles.forEach(file => {
                    if (prFiles.includes(file)) {
                        conflicts.push({
                            file: file,
                            number: pullNum,
                            title: pr.title || `PR #${pullNum}`,
                            author: pr.user ? pr.user.login : 'unknown',
                            url: pr.html_url || `https://github.com/${repoFull}/pull/${pullNum}`,
                            isDraft: isDraft
                        });
                    }
                });
            }

            // Slack Presence Check
            let presenceMap = {};
            let allActive = true;
            if (isSlackConnected) {
                let slackMappings = {};
                try {
                    const mapText = document.getElementById('settingMappings').value.trim();
                    if (mapText) slackMappings = JSON.parse(mapText);
                } catch (e) {}

                for (const rev of reviewersList) {
                    const slackId = slackMappings[rev];
                    if (slackId) {
                        try {
                            const res = await safeCall('slack__get_user_presence', { user: slackId });
                            const active = res && (res.presence === 'active' || res.online === true);
                            presenceMap[rev] = active;
                            if (!active) allActive = false;
                        } catch (err) {
                            presenceMap[rev] = false;
                            allActive = false;
                        }
                    } else {
                        presenceMap[rev] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Calculate Recommendation Rules
            const overloaded = reviewersList.length > 0 && reviewersList.some(r => (reviewerPRCount[r] || 0) >= 5);
            const busy = reviewersList.some(r => {
                const count = reviewerPRCount[r] || 0;
                return count >= 3 && count < 5;
            });

            let finalState = 'SHIP';
            if (conflicts.length > 0 || overloaded) {
                finalState = 'DONOTSHIP';
            } else if (busy || (isSlackConnected && !allActive)) {
                finalState = 'WAIT';
            } else {
                finalState = 'SHIP';
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (finalState === 'DONOTSHIP') {
                    ring.className = "status-ring glow-ring-donotship";
                    icon.innerHTML = '🔴';
                    title.textContent = "Do Not Ship";
                    sub.textContent = "Conflicts / Overload";
                } else if (finalState === 'WAIT') {
                    ring.className = "status-ring glow-ring-wait";
                    icon.innerHTML = '🟡';
                    title.textContent = "Wait / Coordinate";
                    sub.textContent = "Busy / Offline";
                } else {
                    ring.className = "status-ring glow-ring-ship";
                    icon.innerHTML = '🟢';
                    title.textContent = "Ship Now";
                    sub.textContent = "Optimal Window";
                }

                if (conflicts.length > 0) {
                    let html = '<div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-height: 250px; overflow-y: auto;">';
                    conflicts.forEach(c => {
                        let advisor = '';
                        if (!c.isDraft) {
                            advisor = `
                                <div class="advisor-card">
                                    <div style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 2px;">💡 Wait & Coordinate</div>
                                    <div>PR #${c.number} is approved / ready to land. Sync main first:</div>
                                    <div class="code-snippet">git checkout main && git pull origin main && git merge main</div>
                                </div>
                            `;
                        } else {
                            advisor = `
                                <div class="advisor-card">
                                    <div style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 2px;">💡 Proactive Local Merge</div>
                                    <div>PR #${c.number} is still a draft. Merge their branch locally to resolve early:</div>
                                    <div class="code-snippet">git fetch origin && git merge origin/their-branch</div>
                                </div>
                            `;
                        }

                        html += `
                            <div class="conflict-card">
                                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;">
                                    <span class="file-tag">${c.file}</span>
                                    <span style="font-size: 10px; color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold;">Conflict Risk</span>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <a href="#" onclick="window.archestra.ui.openLink('${c.url}'); return false;" style="color: #22d3ee; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 600;">PR #${c.number}: ${c.title}</a>
                                </div>
                                <div style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 10px;">Author: @${c.author}</div>
                                ${advisor}
                            </div>
                        `;
                    });
                    html += '</div>';
                    conflictContent.innerHTML = html;
                } else {
                    conflictContent.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); text-align: center; color: #34d399; font-weight: bold;">🟢 Zero file conflicts detected with open PRs!</div>';
                }

                renderReviewers(reviewerPRCount, presenceMap);

            }, 1200);
        }

        function handleAuthError(url) {
            const ring = document.getElementById('statusRing');
            const conflictContent = document.getElementById('conflict-container');
            const authErrorContainer = document.getElementById('authErrorContainer');

            ring.className = "status-ring glow-ring-ready";
            document.getElementById('statusTitle').textContent = "Auth Required";

            authErrorContainer.style.display = 'block';
            authErrorContainer.innerHTML = `
                <button onclick="window.archestra.ui.openLink('${url}')" class="btn-cyan">
                    <span>🔒 Authorize GitHub Access</span>
                </button>
            `;
            conflictContent.innerHTML = '<p style="color: #fbbf24; font-size: 11px;">GitHub authentication is required to scan open PRs. Please click authorize above.</p>';
        }

        initApp();
    </script>

</body></html>

    - Inputs for: Repository (`owner/repo`), Feature Branch (`head`), and Base Branch (`main`).
    - Collapsible "Manual Override" input box for typing comma-separated modified file paths (e.g. `src/App.js, src/utils.js`).
    - "Analyze Shipping Window" action button styled with a cyan/blue gradient and glowing shadow.

    ### 4. Right-Column Dashboard (Width 2/3)
    - **Top Card: Recommendation Ring**:
      - A large central glowing circular status ring (`transition: all 0.7s`).
      - 🔴 **DO NOT SHIP**: If file conflicts exist OR reviewers are overloaded (>=5 PRs).
      - 🟡 **WAIT / COORDINATE**: If zero conflicts but reviewers are busy (3-4 PRs) or offline.
      - 🟢 **SHIP NOW**: If zero conflicts, reviewers have low load (<=2 PRs), and reviewers are active on Slack (or if Slack is disconnected).

    - **Bottom Sub-Grid (2 Columns)**:
      - **Column 1: Conflict Risk Analysis**:
        - Displays matching modified files and conflicting PR badges (showing PR #, Title, and Author).
        - **Conflict Resolution Advisor Card**: When a conflict is found:
          * If PR is draft/in-progress: Show action card with copyable command: `git fetch origin && git merge origin/their-branch`
          * If PR is approved/ready: Show action card with copyable command: `git checkout main && git pull origin main && git merge main`
      - **Column 2: Reviewer Capacity & Slack Presence Dashboard**:
        - Reviewer load progress bars (Green <=2, Yellow 3-4, Red >=5 PRs).
        - Slack status: Check `archestra.tools.list()`. If Slack is disconnected, show a gray badge "🔒 Connect Slack MCP server in Registry", set status dots to
  neutral gray (🔘), and display a disabled "Notify Me on Slack" button with a lock icon (🔒).

    - When "Analyze" is clicked:
      1. Get feature branch files using `archestra.tools.call('github', 'get_commit', { owner, repo, ref: headBranch })` (or use Manual Override text if provided).
      2. Get open PRs using `archestra.tools.call('github', 'search_pull_request', { owner, repo, state: 'open' })` (or `list_pull_request`).
      3. For each open PR, call `archestra.tools.call('github', 'pull_request_read', { owner, repo, pull_number })` to get modified files and assignees.
      4. Compare file arrays and populate conflict cards and reviewer load counters.
      5. Catch `{code: 'auth_required', url}` errors and render a button that calls `window.archestra.ui.openLink(err.url)` when clicked.

      - 🟡 **WAIT / COORDINATE**: If zero conflicts but reviewers are busy (3-4 PRs) or offline.

          * If PR is approved/ready: Show action card with copyable command: `git checkout main && git pull origin main && git merge main`

        - Reviewer load progress bars (Green <=2, Yellow 3-4, Red >=5 PRs).
